A [[human]] '''officer''' lived during the [[Imperial Era]] and worked for [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]'s [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]] in [[5 BBY]]. When [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] sought a [[Kenari]] human [[Gender|male]] on [[Ferrix]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], for questioning in the [[death]]s of [[Verlo Skiff]] and [[Kravas Drezzer]], the officer participated in the investigation.<ref name="Kassa" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The officer first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' television series episode "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]],"<ref name="Kassa" /> which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref> The character is portrayed by [[Dawn Sievewright]] and credited as "Officer #2."<ref name="Kassa" />
